name: Find Maximum
code:
# Find Maximum (RISC-V assembly)
# Finds the largest element of a[0] .. a[n-1]
#
# a0 = base address of the array
# a1 = number of elements n
# t0 = running maximum

    li a0, 0x0          # base address of the array
    li a1, 0xA          # n = 10 elements
    lw  t0, 0x0(a0)     # max = a[0]
    li  t1, 0x1         # i = 1

loop:
    bge t1, a1, done          # i >= n -> finished
    slli t2, t1, 0x2          # t2 = i * 4
    add t2, a0, t2            # t2 = &a[i]
    lw  t3, 0x0(t2)           # t3 = a[i]
    blt t3, t0, skip          # a[i] < max -> keep the old maximum
    mv  t0, t3                # max = a[i]
skip:
    addi t1, t1, 0x1          # i++
    j loop

done:
    mv a0, t0                 # a0 = the maximum value
